This is a straightforward probability calculation — a closed-form math problem with a single correct answer. Both models can handle it, but Petrel-235B has the edge on the relevant capability signals: higher MMLU-Pro (79.6 vs 74.8) and GPQA Diamond (61.8 vs 54.3), which track quantitative reasoning accuracy. Since the user explicitly cares about getting the right answer, I weighted raw reasoning capability most heavily.

The query also has a slightly frustrated, blunt tone, but that's not a safety/moderation concern that would favor Lapwing's profile — it's just a user who wants a correct result. Petrel's stronger reasoning benchmarks make it the better fit. (Note: the task preference data was not a factor here; preferences don't correlate with output quality, so I routed on capability.)
